news.title: Road to World Cup: Filipinas to face NZ in friendlies
news.lede: The Philippine Women’s National Football Team (Filipinas) will play a two-game series against the New Zealand Football Ferns on November 29 and December 4, 2026, at Porirua Park in Wellington, as part of the team’s preparations for the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup in Brazil. The Philippine Football Federation (PFF) is inviting Filipinos in New Zealand to come to the games and support the team. “We have fantastic Filipino fans in New Zealand, and we would love to see as many of them as possible at Porirua Park. When the Filipino community fills the stands, it makes a real difference to the players.

news.title: Asian football endorses Infantino re-election as FIFA president
news.lede: The head of the Asian Football Confederation on Friday said the region supported Gianni Infantino's bid for re-election as FIFA president following fierce criticism of his aborted World Cup selloff plan." I think that we reaffirm our full commitment, of course, to supporting you and your leadership as you seek a new mandate as FIFA president," said Sheikh Salman, in a significant boost to Infantino's prospects. news.title: World Cup trophy used by Messi in most-liked Instagram photo for sale
news.lede: The trophy and card with Leo Messi holding it after winning the 2022 World Cup. (Richmond Auctions via SWNS). A replica World Cup trophy used by Lionel Messi in an Instagram post which became the most-liked photo in the world is for sale. Argentina lifted the real solid gold trophy after squeezing past France on penalties during their historic campaign at the 2022 World Cup in Qatar.

news.title: China women's football boss leaves eight months before World Cup
news.lede: Ante Milicic has left his post as coach of China's national women's team, the football association said on Friday, eight months before the World Cup." After friendly communication and consultations between both sides and considering Mr. Ante Milicic's family situation, the Chinese Football Association has decided he will no longer serve as head coach," the CFA said in a statement.

news.title: Gianni Infantino is endorsed by the Asian Football Confederation for another term as FIFA president
news.lede: Posted: Oct 22, 2026 / 11:58 PM CDT. Updated: Oct 23, 2026 / 12:02 AM CDT. TOKYO (AP) — The head of the Asian Football Confederation said Friday the body is endorsing Gianni Infantino for another term as FIFA president. The AFC has 47 member confederations.
